inputs.identity_boundary: Only parent has a statutory ledger. Economic portfolio, cash attribution and realization cohorts are not legal entities. Foreign entities never receive Chinese reserve parameters.

inputs.owner_cash_attribution: group cash less 40% of publishing-chain cash budget 3.5595825702; not published cash location
inputs.realization_boundary: Tail cash is an equity valuation realization budget, not a forecast of legally declared dividends. Foreign taxation, solvency, procedures and governance are represented by finite delay and cash friction, not invented registered capital. Five-year holder cash remains parent-constrained.

method: Parent-constrained five-year distributions plus economic equity realization tail; no synthetic legal subsidiary pools
